default.description: Nine tickets across four 284px columns (28px top margin per card): overdue dine-in, takeaway, modified, cancelled, partially cancelled with resolved disposition, duplicate, aggregator, comments, and one flipped card with the Serve overlay. In rtl the columns run from the right.
